tree: What is a 360 degree customer view in CRM?
A 360-degree customer view puts everything about one customer on one screen: contact details, messages, orders, bookings, payments and support history.
Customer details are scattered across inboxes, calendars and payment apps.
Your team opens one profile and sees the full history before they reply.
Customer 360 software brings each customer’s history together.
See everything related to your customers in one place, across all touchpoints.
See all calls, emails, messages, bookings, orders, payments and support tickets in a single timeline.
